recap.title: Rinx Hockey 14U Silver - Skillman Pulls Away From LI Sharks 14U Silver - Manno, 9-3, to Stay Unbeaten
recap.lead: Rinx Hockey 14U Silver – Skillman scored four times in the first period and four more in the third to beat LI Sharks 14U Silver – Manno 9-3 on Sunday at The Rinx. The LIAHL 14U Silver win kept Rinx perfect at 5-0-0-0, while the Sharks fell to 2-3-1-0.

recap.title: Fine Scores Twice as Unbeaten Rinx Skillman Beats Peconic Diaz 7-1
recap.lead: Cameron Fine scored twice and six different players found the net as Rinx Hockey 14U Silver – Skillman beat the Peconic Wildcats 14U Silver – Diaz 7-1 on Saturday at The Rinx. Rinx Skillman outshot Peconic 52-17 and remained perfect at 4-0-0-0.

recap.title: Five Different Scorers Lift Rinx Skillman Past North Park Pala, 5-1
recap.lead: Five different players scored for Rinx Hockey 14U Silver – Skillman in a 5-1 win over North Park Hockey 14U Silver – Pala on Saturday at The Rinx. Brody Meyer, Luka Mazzarone, Konstantinos Krokidis, Aedan Dowling and Luke Ventura each had one goal as Skillman improved to 3-0-0-0 in LIAHL 14U Silver play.

recap.title: Ohliger Scores Twice as Rinx Hockey Shuts Out Great Neck Bruins 7-0
recap.lead: Ryan Ohliger scored two goals and Joseph Azar recorded a shutout as Rinx Hockey 14U Silver – Skillman beat the Great Neck Bruins 14U Silver – Bowden 7-0 in LIAHL 14U Silver play Sunday at The Rinx. The win moved Rinx Hockey to 2-0-0-0. Great Neck Bruins dropped its season opener and sits at 0-1-0-0.

recap.title: Rinx Skillman Beat Peconic Diaz 8-3 Despite Clark Beltram Hat Trick
recap.lead: Rinx Hockey 14U Silver – Skillman beat the Peconic Wildcats 14U Silver – Diaz 8-3 on Saturday at Peconic Ice Rink in the season opener for both LIAHL 14U Silver teams. Six different Rinx players scored, while Peconic’s Clark Beltram recorded a hat trick and accounted for all of his team’s goals.
